inference: A simple unlocked-clock phase-drift model predicts about1.13us per UI for the measured about709ppm clock mismatch. The observed bad-stateMONITOR recurrence medians1.13-1.155us are close. This is consistent with repeated sampling-phase slips and intermittent PCS synchronization, not proof of that unique physical mechanism.
assumptions: Use repaired recovered clock as proxy for peer serial bit rate; no change of peer/source between stages.
Use mean clock mismatch as if a continuous frequency offset. Missing/irregular clock pulses could have a similar mean and are not excluded.
limits: No direct analog phase-slip or jitter waveform measured.
PCS synchronization detector and data pattern affect event cadence; intervals have significant spread.
Mode1-only bad state and post-PMA frequency are separate acquisition stages in the same cold failed state.
Nominal SYS200MHz event timing; not independent external time calibration.
Does not identify the board-level trigger of initial RX/PMA/CDR misinitialization.
